  source_report_sha256 (actual immutable producer report hash), head (captured head), and
  claim_generation (captured source_provenance claim_generation or landed_evidence
  owner_generation). Missing report/result or a historical unknown binding stays Unknown; name the
  missing proof and responsible owner in this report. Never wait, retarget, launch another review
  or run suites to fill it.
  A single unbound engineer proposal covers the report findings. For multiple or narrower
  correction proposals, supply review_findings as a list of exact finding texts; distinct findings
  retain distinct identities. Repeated intake reuses the linked correction and preserves every
  historical item and attempt.
  For each Major, include a structured frontmatter findings entry with severity, text (the exact
  finding text), and correction_check: the specific focused control/command and expected corrected
  behavior. Structured findings are canonical per severity: if you include any entries of a
  severity, include every finding of that severity there; body bullets of that severity are
  display summaries. For a severity with no structured entries, intake uses its body bullets.
  Minors may therefore remain body-only when only Majors are in frontmatter. Name failed and unrun
  proof locations in artifacts. Do not execute the checks; the fixer inherits them.
